description: rojak is a Python library and command-line tool from Imperial College London for aviation turbulence analysis. It computes 27 turbulence diagnostics from meteorological fields and converts diagnostic values to eddy dissipation rate. The package can process ERA5 pressure-level data and retrieve or process aircraft turbulence observations from NOAA and the Met Office AMDAR collections. Outputs support evaluation of turbulence diagnostics and analysis of changes in the probability of encountering hazardous conditions. Spatial coverage and time range depend on the supplied meteorological and aircraft observations. The public repository provides documentation and installation instructions, and source code is free under Apache-2.0. Dask supports distributed processing of large inputs. A limitation is that the developers describe the API as subject to change and the documentation as incomplete. Input-data access and suitability remain separate requirements, and the tool is not a validated operational flight-routing service. Existing data-era5-reanalysis identifies one input source. No data were downloaded and no forecasts were run.
